# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Burrows Estates are delighted to present this very spacious, bright dual aspect apartment overlooking Dublin City. This two bedroom apartment offers very spacious living accommodation with the added convenience of an allocated parking space. Overlooking Dublin city, it is conveniently located very close to shops, restaurants, creches, M50, N11 and well serviced by bus routes to the city and Luas.
